notes.title: Difficulty reduction announcement,Improvements for the player controller
notes.notes:
Based on recent feedback from players, the game input controls have been adjusted in the latest version 1.06 for difficult controls and difficult situations to observe.

[olist]

[b][*] Added a numeric display for TargetNote so players can observe Note order.

[*] mouse Right-click can now also use the Left-click.[/b]

[/olist]
